messages:
emma: quick ping  opened PR 544 to tidy console/observability docs. found 3 small issues: kv-cache example uses `kv_cache_key` but runtime expects `kv_prefix`, missing C# tracehook snippet for SDK parity, and one internal docs link 404s. can someone pick these up?
aj: i can normalize the kv key to `kv_prefix` across docs. will add a docs-lint rule to catch `kv_cache_key` and add a one-line migration note in the migration guide.
rachel: i can add the C# snippet. keep it minimal (create hook, attach context, set `token_cost_usd` + `latency_ms`). will keep under 8 lines.
docs-bot: PR 544 opened by emma  reviewers: @aj @rachel. CI: docs-link-check running.
emma: the broken link is in docs/observability/kv-cache.md -> anchor `#usage-examples` changed to `#examples-usage`. small anchor fix or alias will do.
infra: docs-link-check result: the page loads 200 but anchor `#usage-examples` 404. adding redirect/alias in site config. infra ticket #482 opened.
rachel: draft C# snippet: ```csharp
using Redwood.Trace;
var hook = new TraceHook("console-ui");
hook.AttachContext(new Dictionary<string,string>{{"trace_id", traceId}});
hook.SetTag("token_cost_usd", 0.0035);
hook.SetTag("latency_ms", 97);
```
aj: LGTM. i'll push the kv_prefix rename and docs-lint rule. include jq autofix snippet in PR description.
docs-bot: docs-link-check after kv fix & anchor alias shows page OK. infra#482 closed. CI green pending review.
emma: plan: aj will push rename + linter, rachel lands C# snippet, i'll update PR description with migration note and merge once CI passes. target: EOD. thanks! :thumbsup:
/end of thread
